fact: Law 027-2024/ALT of 11 October 2024 provides for a national register of the unique identifier of natural persons, centralising their biographic and biometric data, with the body in charge to be created by decree and enrolment to follow the system's set-up.
system: registre national de l'identifiant unique de la personne physique

fact: leFaso.net reports that Burkina Faso launched on 11 November 2026 mass enrolment of residents into its Registre de l'identifiant unique, after a pilot that enrolled over 16,000 people, with ten-finger and iris capture, deduplication, and a first count due at the end of December 2026.
